stops.title: Order, degree & formation of differential equations
stops.inShort: Order = highest order derivative present. Degree = highest power of highest order derivative after clearing radicals/fractions. Eliminating n arbitrary constants gives an nth-order DE.

stops.title: Variable separable, Homogeneous & Linear DEs
stops.inShort: Variable separable: f(x)dx = g(y)dy. Homogeneous: dy/dx = f(y/x) ⇒ put y = vx. Linear DE: dy/dx + Py = Q ⇒ IF = e^(∫ P dx), solution: y · IF = ∫ (Q · IF) dx + c.

stops.title: Applications (Population growth, Radioactive decay, Newton's law of cooling)
stops.inShort: dP/dt = kP ⇒ P = P₀ e^(kt). Newton's law of cooling: dθ/dt = −k(θ − θ₀).

items.f: dy/dx + P y = Q ⇒ I.F. = e^(∫ P dx),  y·I.F. = ∫ (Q · I.F.) dx + c
items.s: P and Q are functions of x only.

board.text: Write the order of the differential equation √(1 + (dy/dx)²) = (d²y/dx²)^(3/2).
The solution of the differential equation dx/dt = x log x / t is ____.
board.answer: (a) x = e^(ct) (dx/(x log x) = dt/t ⇒ log(log x) = log t + log c ⇒ log x = ct ⇒ x = e^(ct)).

board.text: Solve the differential equation: dy/dx + y/x = x².
board.answer:
Linear DE with P = 1/x, Q = x².
I.F. = e^(∫ (1/x) dx) = e^(log x) = x.
Solution: y · x = ∫ (x² · x) dx + c = ∫ x³ dx + c = x⁴/4 + c.
Thus x y = x⁴/4 + c.

points.text: Identifying P = 1/x, Q = x² and I.F. = x
Integrating y·x = ∫ x³ dx + c ⇒ xy = x⁴/4 + c
